errors.text_span: 切片按顺时针方向排列，百分比从大到小依次为：行为（50%）、状态（20%）、属性（16%）和要素（14%）。
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices are arranged clockwise in descending order of size. However, starting from the largest slice (行为, 50%) and moving clockwise, the next slice is 要素 (14%), not 状态 (20%). The actual visual arrangement of the slices is not in descending order of size.
The chart does not contain a legend (图例). The category names and percentages are labels placed directly on each slice.
The generation prompt asks to include the color for each slice if distinguishable. The slices are presented in four distinct shades of gray/black, but the description does not mention the colors.
